method: Video sequentially decoded from frame 0 to EOF (1043 actual frames); saved all frames in five inclusive +/-8 windows. Each of 85 frames visually inspected in clean strips and 3x cap zooms. Center, cap endpoints, and current-frame 5/7cm tick x coordinates manually transcribed. No detector-derived coordinates used as labels.
exposure_disclosure: V4 buffer rows were read to identify samples and included detector fields; their values were not used to set visual labels. User later supplied rejection reasons; these were not used to infer ball locations or visibility. This is a separate-agent review, not a blinded human study.
coordinates: Zero-based original 1280x720 pixels; x right; frame numbers are sequential decoded indices.
tolerance_note: Approximate visual uncertainty bounds, not statistically validated. Endpoint/anchor uncertainty is added conservatively for crossing decisions.

region_definition.local_audit: All five windows cross only left boundaries; right boundary is far beyond every cap. Current-frame 5/7 ticks are visually read, not copied from projected detector ROI. Exact detector ROI/gooddomain may differ.

visibility_definitions.complete_visible_cap: Visible upper cap has identifiable left and right ends in original image; DOES NOT mean entire sphere visible or cap entirely inside ROI.
visibility_definitions.partial_search_cap: ROI boundary passes through visible cap; image itself may still show complete cap.
visibility_definitions.boundary_uncertain: Pixel tolerance spans a cap/ROI classification boundary.

windows.coverage_note: Window brackets this local left-edge passage through both search and core boundaries, including cap leading/trailing edge passages. Does not claim entire oscillation or both travel directions.

events.note: Derived only from manually read coordinates and per-frame visual ruler ticks; bounds conservative, not exact detector ROI/gooddomain crossings.
events.equality_convention: At x equal to boundary, nominally inside; boundary uncertainty still applies.
